say:1:1131313001:1.text: The statue's disappearance isn't news anymore. Who doesn't know about it by now?
say:1:1131313001:1.source_cn: 圣石镇的地标建筑眨眼间失踪，现在已经人尽皆知，谁会不知道？
say:1:1131313001:1.male: The statue's disappearance isn't news anymore. Who doesn't know about it by now?
say:1:1131313001:1.female: The statue's disappearance isn't news anymore. Who doesn't know about it by now?

say:2:1131313002:1.text: The knights have been here multiple times, asking questions. We've already told them everything we know.
say:2:1131313002:1.source_cn: 骑士团已经来询问过好几轮，秘银商会把观察到的线索都上报了。
say:2:1131313002:1.male: The knights have been here multiple times, asking questions. We've already told them everything we know.
say:2:1131313002:1.female: The knights have been here multiple times, asking questions. We've already told them everything we know.

say:3:1131313003:1.text: Now that the statue is gone for good, I have to seize this opportunity. Please don't hold me up any longer.
say:3:1131313003:1.source_cn: 神像失踪已经成为既定事实，现在是做出行动的时候，请不要...
say:3:1131313003:1.male: Now that the statue is gone for good, I have to seize this opportunity. Please don't hold me up any longer.
say:3:1131313003:1.female: Now that the statue is gone for good, I have to seize this opportunity. Please don't hold me up any longer.
